snippet.title: Servant Of The Lake Release Date Trailer - Story-Rich Showcase 2026
snippet.description:
Welcome to the Vanderboom house, home to the infamous Vanderboom family! Visitors are arriving soon, and you are meant to start your housekeeping duties immediately! Solve the puzzles needed to fulfil your daily tasks, look after the household, welcome the visitor and ensure their comfort while helping the family achieve their alchemical ambitions!

Servant of the Lake is Rusty Lake’s most ambitious premium point-and-click adventure in years. From the creators of the Cube Escape series, The Past Within, and Underground Blossom.

Wishlist Servant of the Lake now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3636770/Servant_of_the_Lake/
